categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches `depends/funcs.mk` and carries the 'Build system' label.
categories.rationale: Fixes depends package builds picking up host system libraries instead of depends-built dependencies. The author notes this resolves 'a build failure in native_libmultiprocess where cmake would find the system (nix) CapnProto 1.2.0 instead of the depends-built CapnProto 1.4.0, resulting in a compile-time version mismatch error'.
